name: Tostitos Medium Chunky Salsa (Onion & Pepper WARNING)
whyItWorks: Loaded with raw diced yellow onions, jalapeño chili peppers, garlic powder, vinegar, and whole tomato seeds. The combination of concentrated fructans, capsaicin, and sharp seeds triggers severe intestinal cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active disease. Switch to Fody low-FODMAP garlic-free salsa.
